response.sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS leftover FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(leftover) AS overall_avg FROM valid) SELECT v.event_status AS status, AVG(v.leftover) AS avg_leftover, AVG(v.leftover) - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM valid v CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.event_status, o.overall_avg;
